title: Cold-chain monitoring rollout
needs: Northwind lost two loads of dairy in August when reefer units failed overnight and nobody saw the alarm. They want live temperature on every truck, and someone woken up when it drifts.
requirements:
- Alerts within 5 minutes of a 2 °C excursion
- Works on their existing Thermo King units (and six older Carrier trailers)
- Audit exports their QA team can give Tesco and Waitrose
- Data hosted in the UK
- Bristol depot live before 15 December
decision_criteria: Priya Shah (QA lead) and Tom Hale (ops director) decide together. Tom cares most about the Christmas date; Priya about audit-grade data.

title: Dispatch automation pilot
needs: Planners at the Leeds hub build routes in spreadsheets from 04:00 for a 07:00 departure, and late orders break the plan.
requirements:
- 90-day pilot at Leeds (34 vans)
- Order import from Dynamics 365 SCM
decision_criteria: Marcus Lee (network planning) needs a one-page summary for his managing director to approve the pilot.

title: Patient transport scheduling
needs: Patient transport between four sites is booked by phone and planned on a whiteboard.

title: GDP temperature audit trail
needs: Quality team spends two days a month assembling GDP evidence.
